data.one_liner: A native Dart AMQP 0.9.1 client library supporting TLS and asynchronous API.
data.what_it_does: Provides a native Dart client for AMQP 0.9.1 brokers like RabbitMQ. It features an asynchronous API with support for streams, pluggable authentication providers, TLS connections, publish confirmations, and heartbeats.
use_when: You need to connect a Dart application to an AMQP 0.9.1 broker like RabbitMQ.
Your application requires consuming from queues or publishing messages via exchanges using an asynchronous API.
avoid_when: You need automated recovery of client topologies when re-establishing dropped connections.
You require support for AMQP protocol versions other than 0.9.1.
strengths: Implements almost the entire AMQP 0.9.1 specification natively in Dart.
Supports TLS, pluggable authentication, heartbeats, and publish confirmations.
weaknesses: Does not currently support automatic recovery of client topologies upon reconnection.
Missing support for basic get and recover-async protocol features.
